assessments.rationale: evd-003 and evd-004 document that the Tracking Service maintains per‑parcel tracking state in the Tracking Store and that Object Storage holds proof‑of‑delivery photos, so customer data is clearly retained after operational processing. evd-004 also notes undocumented retention for Data Warehouse copies, showing that retention controls are at least incompletely specified. However, the documents say nothing about requirement req-DATA-002, about threat thr-002, or about any retention policy for the Tracking Store or Object Storage. The architectural facts behind the applicability_reason are documented, but the conclusions that req-DATA-002 is applicable to thr-002 and that its status for this threat is unverified are not directly established.
